# File format reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m albedo.release --docs` from python/albedo/release_spec.py in the albedo_sim repository; do not edit by hand. -->

Every group, dataset and attribute of the released HDF5 files is listed below. Paths: `name` is a dataset, `name/` a group, `path@attr` an attribute (`@attr` on the root group); `<...>` stands for any of the group names given in the text. In the released files every dataset also carries the attributes `units` and `description` with the content of these tables (groups carry `description`).

Units: `ph` photons; intensities are per steradian and per keV of photon energy; `GV` gigavolt (rigidity, or modulation potential); `dimensionless` ratios and fractions; arrays are float64 unless stated otherwise. Energy axes are bin edges (N + 1 values for N bins); binned quantities are bin averages.

## `albedo_cxb_reflection.h5` — CXB reflection

Reflection of the cosmic X-ray background (CXB) by the Earth's atmosphere: emergent intensity I(E, b), angle-integrated albedo and whole-Earth spectra at two observer distances, for five CXB normalisations. Unscattered CXB photons (crossing the limb without interacting) are excluded.

| Item | Shape | Units | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@description` |  | text | Short description of the file. |
| `@R_earth_km` |  | km | Radius of the (spherical) Earth of the model; the atmosphere extends from R_E to R_E + 400 km. |
| `@n_primaries` |  | dimensionless | Number of simulated CXB primary photons (all production chunks). |
| `@chunks` |  | JSON text | Provenance: the production chunk files (paths in the simulation repository). |
| `e_edges` | (141,) | keV | Photon energy bin edges: 1 keV-10 GeV, 20 logarithmic bins per decade (140 bins). Spectra are per keV, averaged over each bin. |
| `b_edges` | (176,) | km | Impact-parameter bin edges: distance of the line of the escaping ray from the centre of the Earth. Bins 0-19, the Earth disk (b < R_E = 6371 km), in equal steps of mu = sqrt(1 - (b/R_E)^2) from 1 to 0 (mu is the cosine of the angle from the vertical at which the ray line meets the ground); bins 20-169, the limb, tangent altitude t = b - R_E from 0 to 150 km in 1 km steps; bins 170-174, t = 150-400 km in 50 km steps. |
| `e0_edges` | (141,) | keV | Primary-photon energy bin edges of the underlying response matrices. Not needed to use the intensities. |
| `albedo_C08_eq9` | (140,) | dimensionless | Albedo of Churazov et al. (2008, their Eq. 9) at the geometric centres of the energy bins, for comparison with `<cxb_model>/albedo_disk`. |
| `<cxb_model>/` |  |  | One group per CXB spectrum, all with the shape of Gruber et al. (1999) and the normalisation in `scale_vs_gruber99`: `gruber99` (reference, 1.00), `churazov07` (1.10), `ajello08` (1.06), `turler10` (1.00) and `frontera07` (1.00). The last two are identical to `gruber99` and are kept for bookkeeping. The reflected emission is proportional to the CXB normalisation. |
| `<cxb_model>@reference` |  | text | Reference of the CXB normalisation. |
| `<cxb_model>@scale_vs_gruber99` |  | dimensionless | CXB normalisation relative to Gruber et al. (1999). |
| `<cxb_model>/I_E_b` | (140, 175) | ph cm-2 s-1 sr-1 keV-1 | Emergent intensity of the reflected CXB along rays of impact parameter b, averaged over each (E, b) bin. Axes [E, b]. Valid for any observer outside the atmosphere (above 400 km). |
| `<cxb_model>/I_E_b_err` | (140, 175) | ph cm-2 s-1 sr-1 keV-1 | 1-sigma statistical error of `I_E_b`. |
| `<cxb_model>/albedo_disk` | (140,) | dimensionless | Angle-integrated albedo A(E): reflected photons per energy bin, escaping in all directions, divided by the CXB photons incident on the Earth in the same bin (pi I 4 pi R_E^2); only primaries aimed at the Earth disk (b0 < R_E) are counted, as in Churazov et al. (2008). |
| `<cxb_model>/albedo_disk_err` | (140,) | dimensionless | 1-sigma statistical error of `albedo_disk`. |
| `<cxb_model>/albedo_all` | (140,) | dimensionless | As `albedo_disk`, including the grazing primaries (b0 >= R_E) that cross only the atmosphere; same denominator. |
| `<cxb_model>/albedo_all_err` | (140,) | dimensionless | 1-sigma statistical error of `albedo_all`. |
| `<cxb_model>/spectrum_500km` | (140,) | ph cm-2 s-1 keV-1 | Reflected flux from the whole visible Earth for an observer at 500 km altitude (d = R_E + 500 km): F(E) = sum_b I(E, b) Omega_b(d), the integral of the intensity over solid angle (no cosine weighting). |
| `<cxb_model>/spectrum_500km_err` | (140,) | ph cm-2 s-1 keV-1 | 1-sigma statistical error of `spectrum_500km`. |
| `<cxb_model>/spectrum_40000km` | (140,) | ph cm-2 s-1 keV-1 | As `spectrum_500km`, for an observer at 40 000 km from the centre of the Earth (not altitude). |
| `<cxb_model>/spectrum_40000km_err` | (140,) | ph cm-2 s-1 keV-1 | 1-sigma statistical error of `spectrum_40000km`. |

## `albedo_cr_emission.h5` — Cosmic-ray induced emission

Photon emission of the atmosphere induced by galactic cosmic rays, for a whole Earth with a uniform vertical cutoff R_c and solar modulation phi, on a grid of (phi, R_c), per hadronic model and component. Reference spectra (`modern`): force field on local interstellar spectra, Vos & Potgieter (2015) for protons and Bisschoff et al. (2019) for He, e- and e+. Showers develop within a few tens of kilometres of the impact point, so the uniform-Earth emission at R_c is the local emission of a place with that cutoff (see the worked example for a real field).

| Item | Shape | Units | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@R_earth_km` |  | km | Radius of the (spherical) Earth of the model; the atmosphere extends from R_E to R_E + 400 km. |
| `@n_disk` |  | dimensionless | Number of disk bins at the start of `b_edges` (20). |
| `@axes` |  | text | Index order of the intensity datasets (`model` and `component` axes where present). |
| `@band_axes` |  | text | Index order of `band_brightness`. |
| `@components` |  | JSON text | Names of the components along the first axis of `intensity_components`: `p` protons; `he` helium nuclei; `heavy` nuclei with Z > 2 (CNO, Ne-S, Fe, by superposition of the He response, see `settings`); `e-`, `e+` galactic electrons and positrons; `re` re-entrant e+- (the e+- escaping from the nuclear showers, re-injected isotropically over the whole Earth, without cutoff). |
| `@models` |  | JSON text | Names of the hadronic models along the first axis of `intensity_total` and `band_brightness`: `preco` FTFP_BERT_HP with the PreCompound de-excitation in the Bertini cascade (G4CASCADE_USE_PRECOMPOUND=1; reference, first; from v1.1); `ftfp` FTFP_BERT_HP with its default de-excitation (the reference of v1.0.x); `qgsp` QGSP_BIC_HP; `inclxx` QGSP_INCLXX_HP. `preco` and `ftfp` cover the whole primary range with the same primaries; `qgsp` and `inclxx` cover it with half the statistics (from v1.2; up to 10 GeV per nucleon, completed with the reference above, in v1.0-v1.1). Their spread is part of the hadronic systematic uncertainty (see `shifts/hadronic_up` and `shifts/hadronic_down` of `albedo_reference_orbits.h5`). |
| `@reference_model` |  | text | Name of the reference hadronic model (`preco`), the first of `models`; the single-model datasets below are for this model. |
| `@settings` |  | JSON text | Production settings: `spectra` (`modern` or `s07`) and `spectra_doc` (the cosmic-ray spectra at 1 AU); `HEAVY` (Z > 2 groups: [abundance relative to He at equal energy per nucleon, mass number A]); `HEAVY_FACTOR` (sum of abundance x A/4, the factor applied to the He response for Z > 2); `HE_FRACTION` (He/p per GeV/n of the S07 spectra; not used by the `modern` set); `POSITRON_FRACTION` (e+/(e- + e+) of the S07 spectra; null for `modern`); `BAND_keV` (band of `band_brightness`); `cutoff` (cutoff convention). |
| `@line_scaling` |  | JSON text | Line-scaled variant, per line: `model_over_data` (Geant4 line yield / measured yield, SMM and HEAO 3), `line_fraction` (fraction of the content of the energy bin due to the line, reference model) and `fraction_spread` (its spread over phi and R_c). |
| `@chunks` |  | JSON text | Provenance: number of production chunk files per hadronic model and primary species. |
| `e_edges` | (141,) | keV | Photon energy bin edges: 1 keV-10 GeV, 20 logarithmic bins per decade (140 bins). Spectra are per keV, averaged over each bin. |
| `b_edges` | (176,) | km | Impact-parameter bin edges: distance of the line of the escaping ray from the centre of the Earth. Bins 0-19, the Earth disk (b < R_E = 6371 km), in equal steps of mu = sqrt(1 - (b/R_E)^2) from 1 to 0 (mu is the cosine of the angle from the vertical at which the ray line meets the ground); bins 20-169, the limb, tangent altitude t = b - R_E from 0 to 150 km in 1 km steps; bins 170-174, t = 150-400 km in 50 km steps. |
| `e0_edges` | (141,) | keV | Primary kinetic-energy bin edges of the underlying response matrices (total kinetic energy, not per nucleon), 1 MeV-10 TeV, 20 per decade. Not needed to use the intensities. |
| `phi_GV` | (9,) | GV | Solar modulation potential phi of the force-field approximation (Gleeson & Axford 1968). In `albedo_cr_emission.h5` on the scale of the Vos & Potgieter (2015) proton LIS, i.e. of the Usoskin et al. (2017) / Vaisanen et al. (2023) series (solar minimum about 0.40 GV, maximum about 0.80 GV); in `albedo_cr_emission_s07.h5` on the older scale of Usoskin et al. (2005) used by Sazonov et al. (2007): phi_VP15 = 0.645 phi_old + 0.236 GV. |
| `rc_GV` | (17,) | GV | Vertical geomagnetic cutoff rigidity R_c, applied as a sharp cutoff in all directions to the nuclei and to the galactic e+-, uniformly over the whole Earth (one value per grid point). The re-entrant e+- are not cut. |
| `intensity_total` | (4, 9, 17, 140, 175) | ph cm-2 s-1 sr-1 keV-1 | Total CR-induced emergent intensity (sum of the six components) along rays of impact parameter b, for a whole Earth with uniform cutoff R_c. Axes [model, phi, R_c, E, b] (grids `phi_GV`, `rc_GV`, `e_edges`, `b_edges`); model order in `models`. Stored as float32. |
| `intensity_components` | (6, 9, 17, 140, 175) | ph cm-2 s-1 sr-1 keV-1 | As `intensity_total`, per component (order in `components`), the reference model (`reference_model`, index 0) only. Axes [component, phi, R_c, E, b] (grids `phi_GV`, `rc_GV`, `e_edges`, `b_edges`). The sum over components equals `intensity_total[0]`. |
| `intensity_total_disk` | (9, 17, 140, 175) | ph cm-2 s-1 sr-1 keV-1 | Total intensity (the reference model (`reference_model`, index 0)) from the primaries aimed at the Earth disk only (primary impact parameter b0 < R_E); a diagnostic of the contribution of grazing primaries. Axes [phi, R_c, E, b] (grids `phi_GV`, `rc_GV`, `e_edges`, `b_edges`). |
| `intensity_total_line_scaled` | (9, 17, 140, 175) | ph cm-2 s-1 sr-1 keV-1 | `intensity_total[0]` (the reference model (`reference_model`, index 0)) multiplied by `line_scale_factor`: the 511 keV and 1.634, 2.313, 4.440 and 6.129 MeV lines rescaled to the measured yields. Use it for line work. Axes [phi, R_c, E, b] (grids `phi_GV`, `rc_GV`, `e_edges`, `b_edges`). |
| `line_scale_factor` | (140,) | dimensionless | Factor per energy bin of the line-scaled variant: 1 - f + f / r in the bins containing a line (f = `line_fraction`, r = `model_over_data` in `line_scaling`), 1 elsewhere. |
| `band_brightness` | (4, 7, 9, 17, 2) | ph cm-2 s-1 | Photon rate escaping from the whole Earth in the band `settings.BAND_keV` (25-300 keV), divided by 4 pi R_E^2: the mean surface brightness per unit ground area, integrated over the outgoing directions (comparable with C x integral S(E) dE of Sazonov et al. 2007). Axes [model, component (the six of `components`, then the total), phi, R_c, (value, 1-sigma statistical error)]; errors from 8 event replicas. |
| `escaping_leptons` | (9, 17, 2, 100) | s-1 (per bin) | Rate of electrons (index 0) and positrons (index 1) escaping from the atmosphere of the whole Earth, from the nuclear showers (the reference model (`reference_model`, index 0)), per bin of `lep_edges_keV` (not per keV): the source of the re-entrant component. Axes [phi, R_c, species, lepton energy]. |
| `lep_edges_keV` | (101,) | keV | Lepton kinetic-energy bin edges of `escaping_leptons`: 0.1 MeV-10 GeV, 20 per decade. |

## `albedo_cr_emission_s07.h5` — Cosmic-ray induced emission, Sazonov et al. (2007) spectra

Same content and layout as `albedo_cr_emission.h5`, with the cosmic-ray spectra of Sazonov et al. (2007): their Eq. 5 (Usoskin et al. 2005; Burger et al. 2000 LIS) for p and He, Eq. 6 (Webber et al. 1983) for e+- with a positron fraction of 0.1; `phi_GV` is on their (older) scale. For comparison with Sazonov et al. (2007) only; use `albedo_cr_emission.h5` otherwise.

|---|---|---|---|
| `@R_earth_km` |  | km | Radius of the (spherical) Earth of the model; the atmosphere extends from R_E to R_E + 400 km. |

## `cutoff_igrf_<epoch>.h5` — Geomagnetic cutoff grids

Vertical cutoff rigidities from the IGRF-14 internal field at the epoch in the file name (decimal year), on a 2 deg x 2 deg grid at 35 km altitude (the CR emission layer): R_c = r_eq_GV / L^2, with L from the field line through each grid point. The reference is `L_bmin`. External (magnetospheric) fields are neglected. Epochs other than 2025.0 match the dates of the data sets used in the validation.

| Item | Shape | Units | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@epoch` |  | yr | Epoch of the IGRF field (decimal year). |
| `@r_eq_GV` |  | GV | Stormer vertical cutoff at the dipole equator at r = R_E, from the dipole moment of the epoch. |
| `@h_km` |  | km | Altitude of the grid points above the spherical Earth (R_E = 6371 km). |
| `@max_degree` |  | dimensionless | Maximum degree of the IGRF expansion used for the field lines. |
| `@dipole_pole_deg` |  | deg | Northern geomagnetic (dipole) pole of the epoch: [latitude, east longitude]. |
| `@method` |  | text | Method summary. |
| `lat_deg` | (90,) | deg | Geocentric latitude of the grid nodes, -89 to 89 in steps of 2. |
| `lon_deg` | (180,) | deg | East longitude of the grid nodes, 0 to 358 in steps of 2 (periodic). |
| `L_bmin` | (90, 180) | dimensionless | Reference L: (B_0 / B_min)^(1/3), with B_min the minimum field strength along the IGRF field line through the grid point and B_0 the dipole equatorial field at R_E of the epoch. Axes [lat, lon]. R_c = r_eq_GV / L_bmin^2 (GV). |
| `L_apex` | (90, 180) | dimensionless | Alternative L: apex radius of the field line / R_E (geometry only). Axes [lat, lon]. |
| `b_min_nT` | (90, 180) | nT | B_min, minimum field strength along the field line. Axes [lat, lon]. |

## `response_<species>.h5` — Response functions

Response functions of the standard production, one file per primary species in `data/responses/`: `response_cxb.h5` (CXB photons), `response_proton.h5`, `response_alpha.h5` (4He), `response_e-.h5`, `response_e+.h5` (cosmic rays, o-Ps fraction 0.035; nuclei with the reference hadronic model, FTFP_BERT_HP with the PreCompound de-excitation; e+- from the FTFP_BERT_HP production, shared by all hadronic models in the emission tables). The model variants (other hadronic models, o-Ps fractions) are released as emission tables only. Folded with the reference spectra they reproduce the tables of `albedo_cxb_reflection.h5` and `albedo_cr_emission.h5` within 0.5 % per energy bin above 25 keV (up to a few per cent below, where the CR emission is < 1 % of the total) and 0.02 % in broad bands. Z > 2 nuclei are folded on the He response (a nucleus of mass A at energy per nucleon e_n acts as A/4 He nuclei at e_n), and the re-entrant e+- on the e-/e+ responses (`albedo_earth.Response`, `examples/fold_responses.py`).

| Item | Shape | Units | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@primary` |  | text | Primary particle of the file. |
| `@production` |  | text | Production set (Geant4 physics list, o-Ps fraction for the CR). |
| `@axes` |  | text | Index order of `yield`. |
| `@R_earth_km` |  | km | Radius of the (spherical) Earth of the model; the atmosphere extends from R_E to R_E + 400 km. |
| `@R_src_km` |  | km | Radius R_src of the source sphere on which the primaries enter the atmosphere (R_E + 400 km + 1 m), isotropically (cosine law, pointing inwards). |
| `@n_primaries` |  | dimensionless | Number of simulated primaries. |
| `@n_chunks` |  | dimensionless | Number of production chunk files combined. |
| `e0_edges` |  | keV | Primary-energy bin edges (N0 + 1 values), 20 per decade: CXB photons 1 keV-10 GeV (N0 = 140); protons and He 1 MeV-10 TeV of total kinetic energy, not per nucleon (N0 = 140); e- and e+ 0.1 MeV-10 TeV (N0 = 160). |
| `e_edges` | (141,) | keV | Photon energy bin edges: 1 keV-10 GeV, 20 logarithmic bins per decade (140 bins). Spectra are per keV, averaged over each bin. |
| `b_edges` | (176,) | km | Impact-parameter bin edges: distance of the line of the escaping ray from the centre of the Earth. Bins 0-19, the Earth disk (b < R_E = 6371 km), in equal steps of mu = sqrt(1 - (b/R_E)^2) from 1 to 0 (mu is the cosine of the angle from the vertical at which the ray line meets the ground); bins 20-169, the limb, tangent altitude t = b - R_E from 0 to 150 km in 1 km steps; bins 170-174, t = 150-400 km in 50 km steps. |
| `yield` |  | photons per primary | Response Y[c, i, j, k]: escaping photons in energy bin j and impact-parameter bin k per primary of energy bin i entering the source sphere; c = 0 for primaries aimed at the Earth disk (b0 < R_E), c = 1 for grazing primaries. Shape (2, N0, 140, 175), float32. For an isotropic primary intensity I(E0) [cm-2 s-1 sr-1 keV-1]: rate[j, k] = sum_i pi 4 pi R_src^2 (integral of I over bin i) sum_c Y[c, i, j, k] [photons s-1], and I(E_j, b_k) = rate[j, k] / (dE_j 8 pi^2 b db_k) [ph cm-2 s-1 sr-1 keV-1], with R_src and b in cm. Unscattered primaries are excluded. |
| `yield_var` |  | (photons per primary)^2 | CXB file only: Poisson variance of `yield` (photons of different primaries are independent). Fold it with the squared weights for the statistical error. Shape as `yield`. |
| `n_generated` |  | dimensionless | Number of simulated primaries per primary-energy bin, all strata (N0,). |
| `lep_edges_keV` | (101,) | keV | CR files only: lepton kinetic-energy bin edges of `lepton_yield`, 0.1 MeV-10 GeV, 20 per decade. |
| `lepton_yield` |  | leptons per primary | CR files only: electrons (index 0) and positrons (index 1) escaping from the atmosphere per primary of bin i, per bin of `lep_edges_keV`. Shape (2, N0, 100). Folded like `yield`, it gives the escaping e+- rate [s-1 per bin] that feeds the re-entrant component. |
| `coarse_b_edges_km` | (6,) | km | CR files only: edges of the five coarse impact-parameter groups of `yield_replicas` (disk mu 1-0.5, 0.5-0; limb t 0-50, 50-150, 150-400 km). |
| `yield_replicas` |  | photons per primary | CR files only: `yield` from 8 disjoint subsets of the events (event number mod 8), each scaled to the full sample, on the coarse impact-parameter groups. Shape (8, 2, N0, 140, 5). The statistical error of any quantity Q folded from them is std(Q_r) / sqrt(8); use it instead of Poisson errors, since the photons of one shower are correlated. |

## `albedo_reference_orbits.h5` — Reference orbits

Orbit-averaged emission (reflection + CR) for two common low Earth orbits, ready to use for mission design: LEO-EQ (600 km, inclination 5 deg) and LEO-SSO (550 km, 97.6 deg), IGRF-14 cutoffs at epoch 2025.0, solar minimum (phi = 0.40 GV) and maximum (0.80 GV) on the VP15 scale, Gruber CXB, CR with the reference hadronic model (`cr_model`). Averages over 864 positions, uniform in the argument of latitude u (36 values, (k + 0.5) x 10 deg) and in longitude (24 values, (k + 0.5) x 15 deg); position index = 24 i_u + i_lon. No SAA exclusion. The same spectra are in `reference_orbits/<orbit>_<phase>.txt`.

| Item | Shape | Units | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@description` |  | text | Description of the models and of the systematic band. |
| `@bands_keV` |  | JSON text | The four energy bands of the band fluxes, keV: 1-10, 10-100, 100-1000, 1000-10000. |
| `@cxb_model` |  | text | CXB spectrum of the reflection (`gruber99`). |
| `@cr_model` |  | text | Hadronic model of the CR emission (`preco`, see `albedo_cr_emission.h5`). |
| `e_edges_keV` | (141,) | keV | Photon energy bin edges: 1 keV-10 GeV, 20 logarithmic bins per decade (140 bins). Spectra are per keV, averaged over each bin. |
| `<orbit>/` |  |  | One group per orbit: `LEO-EQ`, `LEO-SSO`. |
| `<orbit>@alt_km` |  | km | Orbit altitude (circular orbit). |
| `<orbit>@incl_deg` |  | deg | Orbit inclination. |
| `<orbit>@epoch` |  | yr | Epoch of the IGRF cutoffs. |
| `<orbit>@n_positions` |  | dimensionless | Number of orbit positions in the averages (864). |
| `<orbit>/theta_deg` | (150,) | deg | Nadir angle at the centre of each row of lines of sight (rows uniform in impact parameter up to the top of the atmosphere). |
| `<orbit>/row_sr` | (150,) | sr | Solid angle of each nadir-angle row (full azimuth). |
| `<orbit>/rc_nadir_GV` | (864,) | GV | Vertical cutoff below the spacecraft at each orbit position. |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/` |  |  | Solar-cycle phase: `solar_min`, `solar_max`. |
| `<orbit>/<phase>@phi_GV` |  | GV | Modulation potential (VP15 scale). |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/flux_refl` | (140,) | ph cm-2 s-1 keV-1 | Orbit-averaged omnidirectional flux of the CXB reflection, F(E) = integral of I over the solid angle of the visible Earth (no cosine weighting). |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/flux_cr` | (140,) | ph cm-2 s-1 keV-1 | As `flux_refl`, CR-induced emission. |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/flux_total` | (140,) | ph cm-2 s-1 keV-1 | `flux_refl` + `flux_cr`. |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/sys_up` | (140,) | dimensionless | Upper systematic uncertainty, fraction of `flux_total`: positive shifts of `shifts/` added in quadrature. Statistical errors (< 1 % in broad bands) are not included. |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/sys_down` | (140,) | dimensionless | Lower systematic uncertainty (positive number), fraction of `flux_total`: negative shifts added in quadrature. |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/shifts/` |  |  | Signed fractional shifts of `flux_total` per energy bin, one dataset per systematic term. |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/shifts/hadronic_up` | (140,) | dimensionless | Shift due to the largest positive shift with respect to the reference (FTFP_BERT_HP with the PreCompound de-excitation) among FTFP_BERT_HP with its default de-excitation (full production) and QGSP_BIC_HP and QGSP_INCLXX_HP (all full production); zero where all are lower (CR). |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/shifts/hadronic_down` | (140,) | dimensionless | Shift due to the largest negative shift among the same hadronic models; zero where all are higher (CR). |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/shifts/cr_spectra_iso` | (140,) | dimensionless | Shift due to modified ISO 15390 cosmic-ray spectra instead of the reference spectra (CR). |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/shifts/z2_s07` | (140,) | dimensionless | Shift due to Z > 2 nuclei with the prescription of Sazonov et al. (2007) instead of superposition (CR). |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/shifts/field` | (140,) | dimensionless | Shift due to geomagnetic field inside the atmosphere (dipole test, applied per band to disk and limb rays). |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/shifts/lines` | (140,) | dimensionless | Shift due to line-scaled variant instead of the nominal line yields (CR). |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/shifts/cutoff_dipole` | (140,) | dimensionless | Shift due to centred-dipole cutoffs instead of IGRF (proxy for the approximation of L-based cutoffs). |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/shifts/cxb_norm_up` | (140,) | dimensionless | Shift due to CXB normalisation +10 % (reflection). |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/shifts/cxb_norm_down` | (140,) | dimensionless | Shift due to CXB normalisation -10 % (reflection). |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/shifts/em_lowE_up` | (140,) | dimensionless | Shift due to electromagnetic physics below 3 keV, +7 % on the reflection. |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/shifts/em_lowE_down` | (140,) | dimensionless | Shift due to electromagnetic physics below 3 keV, -7 % on the reflection. |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/intensity_nadir_refl` | (140, 150) | ph cm-2 s-1 sr-1 keV-1 | Orbit-averaged mean intensity of the reflection in each nadir-angle row (azimuth average). Axes [E, row]. |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/intensity_nadir_cr` | (140, 150) | ph cm-2 s-1 sr-1 keV-1 | As `intensity_nadir_refl`, CR. |
| `<orbit>/<phase>/band_flux_along_orbit` | (864, 4) | ph cm-2 s-1 | Total omnidirectional flux in the bands of `bands_keV` at each orbit position. Axes [position, band]. |
| `LEO-SSO_map/` |  |  | Map of the band flux vs the sub-satellite point, 550 km, solar minimum. |
| `LEO-SSO_map@alt_km` |  | km | Altitude (550). |
| `LEO-SSO_map@phi_GV` |  | GV | Modulation potential (0.40, VP15 scale). |
| `LEO-SSO_map/lat_deg` | (41,) | deg | Geocentric latitude of the sub-satellite point, -80 to 80 in steps of 4. |
| `LEO-SSO_map/lon_deg` | (36,) | deg | East longitude of the sub-satellite point, -175 to 175 in steps of 10. |
| `LEO-SSO_map/band_flux` | (4, 41, 36) | ph cm-2 s-1 | Total omnidirectional flux in the bands of `bands_keV`. Axes [band, lat, lon]. |
